# What Professional Cleaners Can and Cannot Do (Cape Town Guide)

**Professional home cleaning** works best when **scope is explicit**. This article is the **expectation-boundaries layer** in Shalean’s cluster: it pairs with [**what is included in deep cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/whats-included-in-deep-cleaning-cape-town) for **line-item scope**, [**which tier to book**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/deep-vs-standard-cleaning-which-to-book-cape-town) for **service selection**, and [**how long cleaning takes**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/how-long-does-house-cleaning-take-cape-town) for **time reality**. It is **not** a move-out bond checklist—use the **move-out checklist** guide when handover is the primary goal.

---

## Quick answer: what can professional cleaners do?

Within the **items you select** at booking, vetted cleaners focus on **hygienic surfaces, floors, kitchens, bathrooms, dusting, and detail** that fits the tier (**standard** vs **deep**) and the **time purchased**. The job is **methodical**, **safe**, and aligned to residential cleaning supplies.

---

## What cleaners typically cannot do (and why it matters)

### Decluttering and “putting your life away”

Cleaning minutes are not **storage therapy**. If surfaces and floors are not reachable, teams spend time clearing friction instead of removing soil.

### Repairs, electrical, plumbing, and handyman tasks

Loose taps, faulty wiring, broken appliances, or structural damp belong to **qualified trades**. Wiping a safe surface is in scope—**improvised repairs** are not.

### Pest control, sewage, and hazardous materials

**Heavy rodent soiling**, **sewage backups**, or **unknown chemical spills** need specialist protocols—not a routine residential visit.

### Unsafe heights and heavy exterior work

**High ladder exterior glass**, **roof gutters**, and similar tasks need equipment and risk planning beyond typical residential bookings unless explicitly scoped.

### “Automatic” oven, fridge, and wall washing

**Oven interior**, **fridge interior**, and **wall washing** are often **add-ons** or separate scope. Default deep work still centres on kitchens, baths, edges, and floors—see [**what is included in deep cleaning**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/whats-included-in-deep-cleaning-cape-town).

### Childcare, pet services, and concierge errands

Professionals work **respectfully around** households—they are not hired as **babysitters**, **dog walkers**, or **personal assistants**.

---

## Safety, access, and trust (Cape Town realities)

Clear **estate rules**, **parking**, and **buzzer notes** prevent aborted visits—especially in dense suburbs and apartment blocks. Store small valuables normally: **professional trust** and **sensible risk** coexist.

---

## How boundaries connect to better outcomes

If the home needs a **reset**, deep scope usually buys the minutes wet rooms deserve—then **standard** can hold the line. If you need **today**, read [**same-day cleaning in Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/same-day-cleaning-cape-town) for routing honesty.

### Mid-article CTA

Pick tier ([**deep vs standard**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/deep-vs-standard-cleaning-which-to-book-cape-town)), confirm checklist intent ([**deep scope**](https://shalean.co.za/blog/whats-included-in-deep-cleaning-cape-town)), then start booking so **can** matches **purchased**.

---

## Blinds, curtains, and textile soil

Lamp shades, heavy drapes, and fabric headboards often hold **dust reservoirs** that surface wiping cannot erase in one visit. Some teams offer **textile add-ons**; many do not. If textiles are the main complaint after a competent surface clean, the honest next step may be **upholstery or curtain services**—not more spray on the same cushion.

---

## Cape Town access patterns that quietly consume minutes

Estate intercoms with missing unit codes, kerb parking two blocks away, and vague “leave with security” notes can erase **10–20 minutes** before cleaning starts. That time is gone from the visit you purchased—so access notes matter as much as detergent.

---

## When a specialist is the honest answer

Chipped stone needing resin repair, failed grout lines that admit water, or a bathroom fan that recirculates moisture may need **trades** before cleaning outcomes stabilise. Cleaning can still improve appearance—but it cannot reverse **hardware failures**.

---

## Frequently asked questions

### Can cleaners move furniture?

**Light** repositioning for access is normal; **heavy lifting** and full rearranging are not assumed.

### Will cleaners wash all my walls?

**Wall washing** is usually separate unless scoped. Default work targets fixtures, surfaces, kitchens, baths, and floors.

### Can cleaners remove bathroom mould completely?

**Surface** cleaning can improve appearance; **substrate mould** needs remediation specialists.

### Is oven cleaning included?

Usually only when **selected** as an add-on or explicit line item.

### Can I request the same cleaner each visit?

**Where routing allows**, continuity is desirable—never a guarantee written in stone.

---

## How to communicate scope without micromanaging

The best access notes read like a **concierge memo**: parking bay, intercom format, pets secured, fragile heirlooms flagged, and which rooms are **out of scope** this visit. That reduces back-and-forth and keeps minutes on soil—not on detective work.

---

## Insurance, breakage, and realistic liability

Residential cleaning assumes **normal household risk**. If an item is unstable (wobbly shelf, cracked glass), note it before the visit. Teams should not be asked to “just quickly” move objects that require two-person lifts.

---

## What success looks like after boundaries are clear

When scope matches soil truth, outcomes feel boring in the best way: wet rooms refresh quickly, kitchens stop feeling tacky between visits, and **standard** maintenance becomes predictable again.

---

## End CTA

Book [**standard cleaning Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/services/standard-cleaning-cape-town) or [**deep cleaning Cape Town**](https://shalean.co.za/services/deep-cleaning-cape-town) with accurate line items, then review [**cleaning prices**](https://shalean.co.za/cleaning-prices-cape-town) before checkout—**clear scope beats surprises**.
